title: First negative number
prompt: first_negative(nums) returns the index of the first negative number, or -1 if there is none. It crashes on some lists.
hints: Run it on [1, 2, 3]. What happens when i reaches 3?
With 'or', Python evaluates nums[i] when i < len(nums) is already False, and that index does not exist.
The if inside the loop already checks for negatives. The loop only needs to stay inside the list.
explanation: The loop condition 'i < len(nums) or nums[i] >= 0' still reads nums[i] after i reaches the end, which raises IndexError when there is no negative. The guard must be just 'i < len(nums)'.
